title: Free closed playtest for your AI asisted game: real players (vetted by me), full recordings, nothing public
author: DomeGameMaster
selftext:
Solo dev here. I built games with claude too, so i know the worry from that PSA thread: post your game, get marked, get review-bombed on launch day.

So i set up something private recently. Small network of real players i've met on a video call. They play your build cold, record their screen (and sometimes voice) for 15 to 30 minutes, and answer your questions. I check every recording before you get it.

Your build is never posted anywhere. Players agree not to share or stream it, and leaking ends their account. Recordings are unlisted links that only you see. No store reviews, no public comments, nothing tied to your launch.

Your first playtest is free. After that, players set their own rate of $3 to $5 a test, and you pay them directly by PayPal after you've seen the test. I don't take any fees from either side. 

If you want a free one, add your game here: [firstimpressions.quest/make](http://firstimpressions.quest/make)

Happy to answer anything in the comments.

Cheers.
